c) At least one bedroom and one bathroom door on the entry level shall be 3' wide minimum.

f) Note on plan that any new doorbell buttons or controls shall not exceed 48 inches above the exterior floor or landing. Where integrated doorbell features must be installed above 48 inches, a standard doorbell button or control shall also be provided at or below 48 inches.
